## Declarations and implementations

    // The signed diagonal offset of the entry: zero on the main diagonal,
    // positive above it, negative below.
    DiagonalOffset(self: SparseMatrixEntry): Integer
        => self.Column - self.Row;

    //==
    // # Sparse shape statistics

    // The number of stored entries, which is not the number of non-zeros when
    // entries repeat a position or store an explicit zero.
    StoredCount(self: SparseMatrix): Integer
        => self.Entries.Count;

    // The number of positions the dense form would occupy.
    DenseCount(self: SparseMatrix): Integer
        => self.NumRows * self.NumColumns;

    // The stored fraction of the dense shape, in [0, 1] for a matrix with no
    // repeated positions. Precondition: the matrix has a non-empty shape.
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sparse_matrix)
    FillFraction(self: SparseMatrix): Number
        => self.StoredCount.ToNumber / self.DenseCount.ToNumber;

    // The complement of FillFraction: the fraction of the dense shape left
    // implicit. This is the number usually quoted as "sparsity".
    Sparsity(self: SparseMatrix): Number
        => 1.0 - self.FillFraction;

    // True when the matrix has as many rows as columns.
    IsSquareShape(self: SparseMatrix): Boolean
        => self.NumRows == self.NumColumns;

    // True when no entry lies off the main diagonal.
    IsDiagonalMatrix(self: SparseMatrix): Boolean
        => self.Entries.All(e => e.IsDiagonal);

    // The trace: the sum of the diagonal entries.
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trace_(linear_algebra))
    DiagonalSum(self: SparseMatrix): Number
        => self.Entries.Reduce(0.0, (total, e) =>
            total + (e.IsDiagonal ? e.Value : 0.0));

    //==
    // # Banded shape
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Band_matrix

    // The width of the stored band: the lower and upper half-bandwidths plus
    // the diagonal itself. This is the per-row stride of Values.
    BandWidth(self: BandedMatrix): Integer
        => self.LowerBandwidth + self.UpperBandwidth + 1;

    // True when the position falls inside the band, and so may be non-zero.
    IsInBand(self: BandedMatrix, row: Integer, column: Integer): Boolean
        => column - row >= -self.LowerBandwidth
        && column - row <= self.UpperBandwidth;

    // The index into Values of a position inside the band. Precondition:
    // IsInBand holds for the position.
    BandOffset(self: BandedMatrix, row: Integer, column: Integer): Integer
        => row * self.BandWidth + (column - row + self.LowerBandwidth);

    // The value at a zero-based position: the banded slot when the position is
    // inside the band, and zero outside it.
    ElementAt(self: BandedMatrix, row: Integer, column: Integer): Number
        => self.IsInBand(row, column)
            ? self.Values[self.BandOffset(row, column)]
            : 0.0;

    // The number of slots the band occupies, including the off-matrix corners
    // the layout stores and ignores. This is the expected length of Values.
    BandSlotCount(self: BandedMatrix): Integer
        => self.NumRows * self.BandWidth;

    // True when the matrix has as many rows as columns.
    IsSquareShape(self: BandedMatrix): Boolean
        => self.NumRows == self.NumColumns;

    // True when the band is the main diagonal alone.
    IsDiagonalMatrix(self: BandedMatrix): Boolean
        => self.LowerBandwidth == 0 && self.UpperBandwidth == 0;

    // True when the band is one off-diagonal wide on each side.
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tridiagonal_matrix)
    IsTridiagonal(self: BandedMatrix): Boolean
        => self.LowerBandwidth == 1 && self.UpperBandwidth == 1;

    // True when nothing is stored above the diagonal.
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Triangular_matrix)
    IsLowerTriangular(self: BandedMatrix): Boolean
        => self.UpperBandwidth == 0;

    // True when nothing is stored below the diagonal.
    IsUpperTriangular(self: BandedMatrix): Boolean
        => self.LowerBandwidth == 0;
}
